notes.title: More content added!
notes.content:
Hello!

In the last weeks I did couple of things:

[h3]New Content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 2 enemies
[*] 5 upgrades
[*] Receiving damage from enemies and fog
[*] Show amount of damage dealt to enemies next to them, red if critical
[*] Upgrade description in level up
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831565/614ef18701422d93a0e1d1e9b8eda81a9f17f9de.gif[/img]

[h3]New Upgrades[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sharp Bullet - improves critical damage chance
[*] Comfortable Shoes - improves movement speed
[*] Medic - improves health regeneration
[*] Second Barrel upgrade - additional bullet is fired
[*] Martial arts practitioner - Improves dash damage
[/list]
